title: Policy Config
description: Schema for privacy policy config JSON files (ARCHITECTURE.md §5.3). Validates structure only: per-field action mapping, permitted co-occurrence set declarations, and the referenced dataset version. It does not encode which combinations are privacy-safe — that enforcement (the co-occurrence guard) is Phase 3 runtime logic, informed by Phase 7 k-anonymity results.

dataset_version.description: PIN → city/state dataset version reference. Pinned convention: the retrieval date (DECISIONS.md P8), format YYYY-MM-DD.

field_actions.description: Per-field policy action mapping. Keys are form field names.

permitted_cooccurrence_sets.description: Each element is one set of derived/generalized attribute names permitted to co-occur within a session (ARCHITECTURE.md §5.2). Structural validity only — not a privacy determination.
